```{r correlation-dataframe-treatment}
treatment_filtered_genes <- filter_discordant(treatment_comparisons, group_col = "treatment")

if (nrow(treatment_filtered_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Rows total:", nrow(treatment_filtered_genes), "\n")
  print(table(treatment_filtered_genes$relationship_category, useNA = "ifany"))
  print(table(treatment_filtered_genes$treatment, useNA = "ifany"))
} else {
  warning("treatment_filtered_genes is empty with current strict thresholds.")
}
dplyr::count(treatment_filtered_genes, treatment, relationship_category)
write.csv(treatment_filtered_genes,
          file = "../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/commongenes correlation discordant treatment.csv")
```






# HEATMAPS

```{r heatmaps}
# first removing unannotated genes
commongenes_treatment %>%
  filter(!is.na(annot)) ->  commongenes_treatment_heatmap

urban_reef_degs %>%
  filter(!is.na(annot)) ->  urban_reef_heatmap

load("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/vsd.RData")
vsd_treatment <- subset(vsd, rownames(vsd) %in% commongenes_treatment_heatmap$gene)
# keep the significance metric in the same gene order as the vsd rows
commongenes_treatment_heatmap <- commongenes_treatment_heatmap[match(rownames(vsd_treatment), commongenes_treatment_heatmap$gene), ]
vsd_site <- subset(vsd, rownames(vsd) %in% urban_reef_heatmap$gene)
# keep the significance metric in the same gene order as the vsd rows
urban_reef_heatmap <- urban_reef_heatmap[match(rownames(vsd_site), urban_reef_heatmap$gene), ]

# Make sure the 'uniHeatmap.R' script is in your working directory
source("uniHeatmap.R")

# heatmap drawing with square cells; the page is sized to fit the cells.
# Up to 100 genes: 9-pt cells with gene names; more genes: smaller square cells (page ~12.5 in tall), names hidden.
draw_heatmap <- function(file, vsd, gene_names, metric, cutoff, sort, gaps_col = NULL) {
  n <- sum(metric <= cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  message(basename(file), ": ", n, " annotated genes")
  if (n < 2) return(invisible(NULL)) # skipped: too few genes pass this cutoff
  show_names <- n <= 100
  cell <- if (show_names) 9 else max(4, min(9, 900 / n))
  pdf_w <- (ncol(vsd) * cell + (if (show_names) 330 else 60) + 110) / 72
  pdf_h <- (n * cell + 140) / 72
  save_plot(file = file, width = pdf_w, height = pdf_h, {
    uniHeatmap(vsd = vsd, gene.names = gene_names, metric = metric, cutoff = cutoff, sort = sort, pdf = F,
               cellwidth = cell, cellheight = cell, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = min(6, cell * 0.8),
               show_rownames = show_names, gaps_col = gaps_col)
  })
}
# shows the heatmaps drawn in a loop in the knitted HTML
show_heatmaps <- function(imgs) {
  imgs <- unlist(Filter(Negate(is.null), imgs))
  if (length(imgs) && isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) knitr::include_graphics(imgs, rel_path = FALSE, dpi = 150) else invisible(imgs)
}

# Treatment
# creating a lookup table of gene ID to gene annotations
gene_names <- as.data.frame(cbind(commongenes_treatment_heatmap$gene, commongenes_treatment_heatmap$annot))
# long annotations are shortened for the row labels (full annotations are in the DEG tables)
gene_names$V2 <- ifelse(nchar(gene_names$V2) > 60, paste0(substr(gene_names$V2, 1, 57), "..."), gene_names$V2)
# heatmaps of LH vs CC genes, columns in design order (grouped by treatment, gaps between treatments)
treat_gaps <- cumsum(rle(as.character(design$treat))$lengths)
treat_gaps <- treat_gaps[-length(treat_gaps)]
treat_files <- c("-1" = "0.1", "-3" = "0.001", "-6" = "1e-6")
hm_treatment <- lapply(c(-1, -3, -6), function(cut) # p < 0.1, 0.001, 1e-6; cutoffs with < 2 annotated genes are skipped
  draw_heatmap(file = paste0("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/heatmap_treatment_p", treat_files[as.character(cut)], ".pdf"),
               vsd = vsd_treatment, gene_names = gene_names,
               metric = -(abs(commongenes_treatment_heatmap$lpv.LH_CC)), # metric of gene significance
               cutoff = cut, sort = c(1:ncol(vsd_treatment)), gaps_col = treat_gaps))
show_heatmaps(hm_treatment)

# Urban vs reef
# creating a lookup table of gene ID to gene annotations
gene_names_site <- as.data.frame(cbind(urban_reef_heatmap$gene, urban_reef_heatmap$annot))
# long annotations are shortened for the row labels (full annotations are in urban_reef_DEGs.csv)
gene_names_site$V2 <- ifelse(nchar(gene_names_site$V2) > 60, paste0(substr(gene_names_site$V2, 1, 57), "..."), gene_names_site$V2)
# columns ordered by habitat, then site
# (uniHeatmap orders columns by order(sort), so 'sort' is a sorting key)
site_key <- 10 * as.numeric(factor(ifelse(design$site %in% c("Star","MacN"), "urban", "reef"), levels=c("reef","urban"))) +
            as.numeric(factor(as.character(design$site), levels=c("Emerald","Rainbow","Star","MacN")))
n_reef <- sum(site_key < 20) # reef columns come first; a gap separates reef from urban

hm_site <- lapply(c(-1, -2, -3, -6), function(cut) # p < 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 1e-6; cutoffs with < 2 annotated genes are skipped
  draw_heatmap(file = paste0("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/heatmap_urban_reef_p1e", cut, ".pdf"),
               vsd = vsd_site, gene_names = gene_names_site,
               metric = -(abs(urban_reef_heatmap$lpv.urban_reef)), # metric of gene significance
               cutoff = cut, sort = site_key, gaps_col = n_reef)) # columns ordered by habitat and site
show_heatmaps(hm_site)
```


# KOG MATCHING

```{r kog-matching}
# Treatment
# LC vs CC 
commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.LC_CC >= 1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "LC_CC_up" = n) -> KOG_LC_CC_up

commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.LC_CC <= -1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "LC_CC_down" = n) -> KOG_LC_CC_down

# CH vs CC 
commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.CH_CC >= 1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "CH_CC_up" = n) -> KOG_CH_CC_up

commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.CH_CC <= -1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "CH_CC_down" = n) -> KOG_CH_CC_down

# LH vs CC 
commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.LH_CC >= 1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "LH_CC_up" = n) -> KOG_LH_CC_up

commongenes_treatment %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA)) %>%
  filter(lpv.LH_CC <= -1) %>%
  count(KOG) %>%
  rename("KOG" = KOG, "LH_CC_down" = n) -> KOG_LH_CC_down

# joining all KOG class sums in a single dataframe
KOG_LC_CC_up %>%
  full_join(KOG_CH_CC_up, by = "KOG") %>%
  full_join(KOG_LH_CC_up, by = "KOG") %>%
  full_join(KOG_LC_CC_down, by = "KOG") %>%
  full_join(KOG_CH_CC_down, by = "KOG") %>%
  full_join(KOG_LH_CC_down, by = "KOG") -> KOG_match
KOG_match <- KOG_match %>% mutate(across(-KOG, ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)))

# melting dataframe for plotting
KOG_match %>%
  melt(id = "KOG") %>%
  rename(comparison = variable, sum = value) -> KOG_melt

# creating a custom color palette
colorCount = length(unique(KOG_match$KOG))
getPalette = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))

# relative abundance plot
KOG_sum <- ggplot(KOG_melt, aes(fill = KOG, y = sum, x = comparison)) +
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))(colorCount)) +
  labs(x = "Comparison",
       y = "Number of DEGs") +
  theme_classic()
KOG_sum
ggsave("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/KOG_treatment.pdf", plot= KOG_sum, width=10, height=6, units="in", dpi=300)

# Urban vs reef
urban_reef_degs %>%
  mutate(KOG = replace(KOG, KOG == "", NA),
         direction = ifelse(lpv.urban_reef > 0, "higher in urban", "lower in urban")) %>%
  count(direction, KOG) -> KOG_urban_reef

# (skipped when there are no urban vs reef DEGs)
if (nrow(KOG_urban_reef) > 0) {
# creating a custom color palette
colorCount = length(unique(KOG_urban_reef$KOG))

# relative abundance plot
KOG_sum <- ggplot(KOG_urban_reef, aes(fill = KOG, y = n, x = direction)) +
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))(colorCount)) +
  labs(x = "Urban vs reef",
       y = "Number of DEGs") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_classic()
print(KOG_sum)
ggsave("../../outputs/transcriptomics/ofav/limma/KOG_site.pdf", plot= KOG_sum, width=10, height=8, units="in", dpi=300)
} else cat("no urban vs reef DEGs: KOG_site.pdf not written\n")
```
